What's a good strategy for learning a new language?
A good strategy combines consistent daily practice with real-world exposure. Start with high-frequency vocabulary and core grammar patterns, then supplement with listening and speaking practice as early as possible rather than waiting until you feel "ready." Spaced repetition systems help retention, and finding a conversation partner or tutor accelerates production skills far faster than passive study alone. Consistency matters more than intensity — twenty minutes daily beats three hours once a week.
